method: Playwright automated desktop interactions plus screenshot inspection; no human participant or cross-week acceptance

rounds.scope: Recovery, capture merge, close and restart

cases.name: round 1: closing capture and restarting keeps the account session usable without an open website
round 1: detail recovery updates original account and preserves custom metadata
round 1: homepage capture suggests exact identity and merges without creating a duplicate
round 1: account editor contains a direct in-app recovery action

rounds.scope: Incomplete data, expiry, concurrency, session isolation and HTTP recovery

cases.name: round 2: delayed DOM and changed selectors still refresh; incomplete data preserves the successful snapshot
round 2: expired login exposes recovery and never replaces old usage with a login page
round 2: wrong visible identity is rejected and late capture cannot overwrite edits
round 2: clearing the saved merged session actually requires login on next refresh
round 2: two accounts keep separate cookies over repeated concurrent refreshes and restart
round 2: temporary HTTP failure recovers once, sustained failure retains the original snapshot

rounds.scope: Formal packaged Electron full regression, dark/narrow/keyboard and 1.2.0 migration
